supporting_observations.claim: The alerted periodic outbound HTTPS activity is visible: proxy CONNECT records for update.chartmate-imaging.net occur from 13:38 through 14:08 UTC at roughly five-minute intervals, including both successful and failed requests.
Endpoint network telemetry attributes these proxy connections to cmupdate.exe, running as ben.carter from C:\Users\ben.carter\AppData\Local\ChartMate\cmupdate.exe.

The activity is plausibly related to the inventoried ChartMate updater, whose expected check cadence is about every five minutes. However, the observed hostname is update.chartmate-imaging.net rather than the inventoried update.chartmate-imaging.com, and the observed executable is under the user's AppData directory rather than the inventoried Program Files location; the evidence does not establish whether these differences are authorized.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show CONNECT hostnames, status, byte counts, durations, and user-agent strings, but not the encrypted HTTPS contents or the remote server certificate.
The available records do not establish the executable's cryptographic signature, hash, provenance, or whether the observed AppData copy is an approved ChartMate installation.
The evidence shows several requests and their process attribution, but does not establish that all relevant endpoint and network telemetry for the entire review window is present.
claims_not_established: Whether update.chartmate-imaging.net is an authorized ChartMate update endpoint or a malicious lookalike.
Whether the observed cmupdate.exe is authentic, approved software, or has been modified.
What content was exchanged in the HTTPS tunnels, or whether any payload was downloaded or executed.
Whether the failed proxy requests reflect ordinary updater retries or a different cause.
additional_evidence_needed: Verify the observed hostname and AppData installation path with ChartMate/vendor and internal software inventory or deployment records.
Collect the executable's hash, signature-validation results, file provenance, and relevant file creation or modification history.
Obtain proxy TLS inspection or certificate/remote-endpoint metadata, if available, and any updater logs or downloaded package details for the alert window.
unrelated_findings: At 13:54:48 UTC, WS-BCARTER-01 connected to FILE-HD-01 over SMB, and FILE-HD-01 logged an ANONYMOUS LOGON using NTLM. This is outside the alerted outbound HTTPS activity and should be reviewed separately. (T015-00253, T015-00255, T015-00256, T015-00257)
